# PATCH_V5_EVIDENCE_MANIFEST_BEGIN
try{
$root="C:\alpaca-bot\ORG_BOT_UNIFIED"
$py="C:\alpaca-bot\ORG_BOT_UNIFIED\code\.venv\Scripts\python.exe"
$log="C:\alpaca-bot\ORG_BOT_UNIFIED\runtime\paper\logs\evidence_manifest.jsonl"

$run_id=[guid]::NewGuid().ToString()

$row=[ordered]@{
ts=(Get-Date).ToString("s")
kind="evidence_manifest_v5"
run_id=$run_id
wrapper="ORG_UNIFIED_RUNTIME_MANAGER.ps1"
wrapper_version="v5"
patch_level="PATCHSPEC_V5"
process_id=$PID
canonical_root=$root
canonical_root_exists=(Test-Path $root)
canonical_python=$py
canonical_python_exists=(Test-Path $py)
profile=$env:TBOT_PROFILE
}

$dir=Split-Path $log
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $dir|Out-Null
($row|ConvertTo-Json -Compress)|Add-Content $log -Encoding UTF8
}catch{}
# PATCH_V5_EVIDENCE_MANIFEST_END
